what: Six validation failures in the locally scaffolded full-service demo have been corrected.
expected: Error graph nodes and edges agree; event state and bucket features reach the inspector; request pages contain one lifecycle row per ID; domain outcomes survive HTTP completion; starter tests can isolate Docker resources.
observed: The same five live API assertions and the fresh-scaffold test scenario now pass; browser checks confirm graph, errors, events, bucket capabilities, request uniqueness and declared-error display.
root_cause: Compiler evaluator selection rejected callable error descriptors. Generated server omitted event/resource runtime inspection. Local event provider hid its administration query. DuckDB listed request lifecycle records without coalescing them. HTTP response completion inferred defect from 500 and overwrote declared outcomes. Starter tests instantiated configured Docker providers without test replacements.
fixed_by: Recognize safe error constructors; expose read-only local event queries and connect generated event/resource runtime sources; rank completed requests before filtering/paging; preserve classified outcomes at response EOF; add explicit resourceProviders: fake setup to starter tests. Live Redis/MinIO/event replay, fresh CLI scaffold tests, unit regressions, browser assertions, typecheck, lint and repository checks pass.

invariants: Successful deliveries remain visible without payload disclosure
Capabilities agree with the selected binding
Completed requests replace started rows before pagination
Declared HTTP outcomes survive a 500 response
Explicit test mode isolates bucket/cache resources; default configuration checks remain enforced

limitations: Release build/start/deployment were not exercised: the demo intentionally uses Docker-only development bindings and has no connected/infrastructure release sources. No cloud or paid-model calls were made.
Historical request/span records retain their original classifications; after assertions select fresh requests and wait for telemetry ingestion.
No baseline commit checkout was used; reproduction compares original and edited code within the existing dirty checkout.
The local upstream Effect checkout lacks core Effect.ts; compatible rc.115 installed source and available upstream Effectable/StackCapture tests were inspected.

notes: Retained all reported before failures and regression outputs. Initial test setup errors were repaired before counting failure evidence.
The old demo CLI did not release its lease on SIGINT/SIGTERM; its obsolete process and telemetry worker were stopped before restarting. Current dev session and Docker services remain running.

Browser regression runner seeds a fresh publication before inspection, since a dev reload begins a new in-memory publication snapshot. Current delivery state remains persisted. It uses fresh browser contexts for separate page assertions; repeated hard navigations in a reused agent-browser context stalled script loading while inspector streams remained open. Existing inspector navigation acceptance also passed independently.
